note: Formal experiment registry (MASTER_PLAN 38). Entries are append-only; results are never overwritten. Namespaces: experiments/<EXP-ID>-<slug>/ holds result.json + report.md only; bulk artifacts are git-ignored runtime outputs.

experiments.title: Phase 1 quantization baseline: reference implementation latency, memory, representation size
experiments.config: uniform quantization L in {8,16,32,64,128,256} x {320x240, 640x480, 1920x1080}, synthetic gradient scene, seed 0, 8 warm-up + 22 measured frames per condition
key_findings: quantization latency is independent of L (~7.5 ms at 1080p for all level counts)
quantized map = 1/3 of raw RGB bytes; float64 luminance intermediate = 8/3 (reported cost)
grayscale float64 conversion dominates pipeline cost; optimization deferred to Phase 8 per plan 3.14

experiments.title: Phase 2 intensity-object extraction: cost of labeling, identity and metadata
experiments.config: vie.objects-config/1 reference (connectivity 4, min_area 1 unless stated); 3 sizes x 4 scenes x L in {8,16,64,256} (5 measured frames + 2 warm-up each) plus a dense per-pixel-noise block at L=256 (320x240 and 640x480 min_area=1, 1920x1080 min_area=2)
key_findings: structured 1080p extraction p50 106-148 ms (2 regions); ramp_bands (one-pixel-wide runs) is the main-matrix worst case at 2.33 s/frame
label maps are int32 = 4 bytes/pixel (4/3 of the uint8 intensity map, 4/9 of raw RGB) - reported, not hidden
dense-noise metadata dominates: 13.3 MB/frame at 320x240 and 53.9 MB/frame at 640x480, ~58x the raw frame; min_area is the lever (discards counted)
latency must be measured untraced: tracemalloc inflates this code 1.36x-16x (measured)
fully dense 1920x1080 noise at min_area=1 (~2.07M records) exceeded 3 GB and is recorded as not measured
experiments.decision: Phase 2 accepted (DEC-0004) on this evidence; optimization deferred to the profiling phase (plan 3.14/8), no rate claimed
